title_zh: 京张公共记忆、荣誉展示与回馈系统
title_en: Jing-Zhang Public Memory, Recognition and Return System

narrative_chain.meaning_zh: 以连续到达、工程维护和公共通行为叙事起点，只使用清权文字、线形与公开来源索引。
narrative_chain.meaning_en: Begin with continuous arrival, engineering care and public passage, using rights-cleared text, linework and public-source indexes only.

narrative_chain.meaning_zh: 把可复现方法、维护贡献和失败修复写进公共记录，不以企业曝光或模型排名替代贡献。
narrative_chain.meaning_en: Record reproducible methods, maintenance contributions and failure repairs; company exposure or model rank does not substitute for contribution.

narrative_chain.meaning_zh: 每次试验结束都归还普通路线、公开回执和下一次复核日期，让退出和修复成为城市能力。
narrative_chain.meaning_en: Every trial returns the ordinary route, a public receipt and the next review date, making exit and repair visible civic capabilities.

node_carriers.carrier_zh: 显示版本、闸门、责任角色、暂停原因、修复状态和复核日期，不显示个人轨迹。
node_carriers.carrier_en: Show version, gate, accountable role, pause reason, repair state and review date; never show personal trajectories.
node_carriers.honor_rule_zh: 只展示有证据、可复演、已清权且有到期日的公共贡献。
node_carriers.honor_rule_en: Display only evidenced, replayable, rights-cleared public contributions with an expiry date.

node_carriers.name_zh: AI原点 · 人工接管纪念台
node_carriers.carrier_zh: 记录被否决、暂停、退回人工和完成修复的决定，公开普通路线如何恢复。
node_carriers.carrier_en: Record rejected, paused, human-return and repaired decisions, including how the ordinary route was restored.
node_carriers.honor_rule_zh: 荣誉属于及时停止、可访问服务和完成修复，不属于未经验证的自动化速度。
node_carriers.honor_rule_en: Recognition goes to timely stops, accessible service and completed repair, not unverified automation speed.

node_carriers.name_zh: 大钟寺 · 人机换乘回执墙
node_carriers.carrier_zh: 把轨道、步行、轮椅、物流与人工服务放进一张可读回执，标明断点和恢复。
node_carriers.carrier_en: Place rail, walking, wheelchair, freight and staffed service in one readable receipt, with breaks and restoration shown.
node_carriers.honor_rule_zh: 只表彰保持完整旅程的跨专业协作；任一普通路线断点都撤下展示并重开复核。
node_carriers.honor_rule_en: Recognise cross-disciplinary work only when the complete journey remains; any ordinary-route break withdraws the display and reopens review.

annual_return_cycle: Q4 publish repair, withdrawal or conditional continuation
international_line: Build to test; publish to repair; return to public use.
evidence_boundary: No heritage interpretation approval, artwork commission, sponsorship, construction, event approval or operating performance is asserted.
